text:
Sam (eng-release): Heads-up: planning rollout tonight 22:00 UTC in the change window. Components: API v2.1.0, runtime kernel-quant v3, console schema toggle, router header-split. Need pin statuses + any blockers. @deploy-bot schedule?

deploy-bot: Scheduled: release-wave-7 queued for 2026-03-21T22:00:00Z. Run ID: rb-1768625300. Use `/deploy status rb-1768625300` to inspect.

Morgan (api): API pinned to v2.1.0 already. No infra changes. Release notes updated: https://short.link/relnotes-1768. Will watch error budget.

Priya (runtime): Runtime: kernel-quant v3 requires a launcher config flip. Pushed staged config to canary pool. Observability: kv-eviction alert may spike on first warmups. Keeping canary for 30m pre-traffic.

Tess (console): Console migration is backward compatible. I added a runtime-toggle flag so we can flip off schema validation if we see 500s in the first 5%.

Anya (router): Router header-split validated in staging. Plan: 10% initial, then 50% after 15m hold. Pin applied on router layer.

Sam (eng-release): Quick check — rollback triggers? error rate threshold and p95 latency bump thresholds? @Elaine will you confirm oncall criteria.

Elaine (eng-oncall): Confirm. Rollback if 5m sustained p95 increase >25ms OR error rate >0.7%. Also trigger if canary OOMs >1 during hold.

Priya (runtime): If runtime OOMs, fallback plan: point canary runners to quant-v2 and scale fallback pool. Command we will use: `runtime rollback rb-1768625300 --variant quant-v2`

Morgan (api): API fallback: route to old model endpoint and set header x-fallback: true. Example patch: `curl -XPOST https://api.redwood.internal/route -d '{"pin":"v2.0.9"}'`

Sam (eng-release): Release notes customer-facing summary ready. @Tess can you add the console toggle steps and quick rollback steps to the notes?

Tess (console): Done. Added section "Console toggle & rollback" in release_notes.md. Link: https://short.link/console-toggle

deploy-bot: Dry run complete. No failures. Next milestone: preflight at 21:20 UTC — smoke tests + canary health checks. Run `/deploy preflight rb-1768625300` to trigger.

Sam (eng-release): Agree. I'll kick preflight at 21:20. Please be on #release-watch for live updates.

Priya (runtime): :thumbsup: I'll watch kv-evict, memory, and kernel warmup logs.

Anya (router): :eyes: Router ready. Holding at 10% for initial 15m window.

Elaine (eng-oncall): I'll be on-call in watch channel and will trigger rollback if thresholds hit.

Morgan (api): If we do rollback, remember to unpin the new API route after rollback to avoid bleed.

Sam (eng-release): :rocket: Thanks all. TL;DR: scheduled 22:00 UTC; preflight 21:20; pins in place; rollback criteria set; notes + links posted. I'll post final go/no-go at 21:40.
